title: Asset sale basket with section cross-reference

agreement.pdf.source_wording: The Borrower shall not sell or transfer assets except as permitted under Section 7.4, provided that other asset sales do not exceed 10% of Consolidated Total Assets in any fiscal year.
exceptions: Permitted dispositions include obsolete equipment sold in the ordinary course of business

cross_references.target_description: Section 7.4 Permitted Dispositions. Permitted dispositions include obsolete equipment sold in the ordinary course of business.
